issues.summary: IsInvalidDataToken flagged empty/whitespace numeric/bit cells as invalid even though Format emits a clean NULL, causing spurious InvalidDataToken degradations on ordinary nullable columns.
issues.resolution: Added string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(raw) short-circuit returning false; theory test covers empty Long, whitespace Double, empty Bit.

issues.summary: BuildFormOrReportExports early-returned when the ir/<category> directory was absent, before the FORM_SPEC_MISSING diff, so a non-empty parserOutputs with a missing ir dir emitted no diagnostics.
issues.resolution: Removed the early return (missing dir -> empty ir-file set); extracted the diff to an internal AddMissingSpecDiagnostics helper with three unit tests.
